title: Gemini 2.0
before: Multimodal models took images and audio in, and emitted text.
problem: Agents need models that also act, natively call tools and produce other modalities.
breakthrough: A model built for the agentic era, with native tool use, multimodal output and experimental thinking modes.
why: It marked Google's reorientation from chat assistant to agent platform.
inherits: Native tool use as a model capability rather than a wrapper.
